title: just-deliver catalog resource type
description: The contract development teams bind to: the name is what the workload asks for (for example 'database'); the platform's mapping picks the engine, and an 'engine' export tells the code which one it got. Unique by name across the catalog.

name.description: Value teams write as 'type' in a workload requirement; same pattern as the workload schema's type.

classes.description: Operational shapes a workload may request with 'class'.

exports.description: The only valid names in ${resource.<id>.<name>}. Every mapping for this type must supply all of them (checked by the resolver, not by this schema).

description.description: What the type gives a team.
